title: Flyout Matrix: Multi-mode Sidebar & Workspace Shuttle Prototype
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: Replace the existing dense left rail with a lightweight, multi-mode flyout matrix that combines quick-route shortcuts, contextual workspace shuttle, and progressive disclosure of per-route cost & rollout state. This ticket captures the prototype, design critiques, trade-offs and observable acceptance criteria needed for handoff to eng and PM for a pilot release. The Flyout Matrix aims to reduce time-to-target by surfacing 1) frequently-used routes, 2) workspace switching controls, and 3) inline cost/rollout badges without adding visual noise.
motivation: Users frequently complain about cognitive overhead of deep nested menus when performing cross-workspace tasks (e.g., switching from env to a customer workspace and inspecting cost trends). We want an affordance that supports fast transient switching, preserves context (open panel state), and enables lightweight telemetry-driven defaults for each customer tier.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates < 2-click workspace switch while preserving active panel state
Cost and rollout badges render at 1600x900 and scale down without overflow
Keyboard-first access: command-palette + numeric hotkeys map to first-row flyout items
Visual regression tests for collapsed/expanded matrix across themes pass
Design token mapping documented for spacing, colors, and badge states
decisions: Prefer flyout overlay anchored to left-edge rather than persistent mini-rail to maximize vertical canvas
Show cost and rollout badges inline (micro-badges) with hover-expanded tooltip for details
Workspace shuttle preserves the last open panel (logs, metrics, traces) when switching unless user chooses 'clear context'
tradeoffs: Overlay reduces permanent rail real estate but introduces transient discovery cost — mitigated via first-run hotspot and keyboard shortcuts
Inline badges add visual noise for novice users; opted for low-contrast outline + micro-CTA to inspect details
Preserving panel state increases mental model complexity for users who expect a fresh workspace; added 'clear context' affordance
implementation_notes: Use CSS transform + will-change for smooth flyout animation; avoid layout thrash on open/close
Badge states: neutral, alert (rollout issues), billing-alert (cost spike); map to existing tokens in tokens.json
Expose an ARIA region for the flyout matrix and ensure focus-trap is conditional for keyboard workflows
Provide dev with a small dataset of mocked workspace metadata (recent routes, cost delta, rollout status) for QA

2025-02-14 - Usability session notes: 6/8 participants completed the switch & inspect flow faster than baseline; two participants missed the collapsed hotspot — added slight pulsing on first-run
next_steps: Incorporate eng feedback on lazy render and focus guard
Prepare a scoped pilot for 10% of users behind feature flag; define telemetry events (open, switch, badge-click, clear-context)
Create a dev handoff packet with Figma frames, tokens mapping, microcopy, and animated Lottie for hotspot guidance
Schedule a PM/Eng/Design sync for 2025-02-18 to finalize API contract for workspace metadata
notes_for_engineering: API should expose: workspace_id, display_name, last_active_panel, cost_delta_24h, rollout_status, priority_badge
Front-end should support virtualization when >30 entries and debounce hover expansion by 150ms
